text:
maria: Quick proposal: split the Ruby SDK into two gems — `redwood-core` (generation + streaming) and `redwood-auth` (token refresh helpers). Goal: smaller install for minimal sampleapps and avoid bundler conflicts. Thoughts? :thinking:

kevin: Sounds good. How do we handle backwards compat for current users?

maria: Keep a compatibility `redwood` gem depending on both for one major, with migration guide in CHANGELOG. Auto-require auth shim when refresh options present.

samir: Streaming retry currently does auth refresh inside the stream loop. If we split, core must expose a lightweight hook so auth logic can live separately without breaking parity.

olga: Agreed. Also update Quickstart to show both minimal no-auth install and full auth flow. Lots of folks hit bundler issues with the full gem.

maria: Draft snippet to call optional refresher:```ruby
if defined?(Redwood::Auth::Refresher)
  Redwood::Auth::Refresher.refresh_if_needed(token_store)
end
```

kevin: Can you show the gemspec change? CI flaked when we bumped oauth2 last week.

maria: Proposed gemspec diff:```ruby
s.add_dependency 'redwood-core', '~> 1.0'
s.add_dependency 'redwood-auth', '~> 1.0'
```

samir: I'll add a CI matrix job that installs `redwood-core` only so we catch minimal-install issues. Our smoke tests currently always install full gem.

ci-bot: build #487 failed on ruby-3.2: bundler conflict with faraday versions. Log excerpt: "Bundler could not find compatible versions for gem \"faraday\": In snapshot: faraday (= 2.0.0) In Gemfile: some-dep (~> 1.0) depends on faraday (~> 1.8)"

olga: This is precisely the onboarding friction we want to avoid. Minimal gem should avoid heavy deps like oauth2/faraday.

maria: Next steps: 1) RFC PR with architecture + migration plan, 2) create `redwood-core` repo and publish alpha, 3) update Quickstart sampleapps, 4) add core-only CI job. I'll open RFC draft tomorrow. Any objections? :thumbsup:

kevin: +1, I can review PRs and help with streaming hooks.

samir: +1, I'll write the CI job and a test to mock the refresh hook.

olga: +1, I'll update Quickstart and docs for constrained environments (Lambda).

maria: Thanks all — RFC draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pulls/512 (draft).
